newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Asia Equity rates 4 Thai banks buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Asia Equity rates 4 Thai banks buy.

text.p: Asia Equity Ltd recommended on Friday that investors buy stocks of Thai Farmers Bank, Siam Commmercial Bank, Bank of Ayudhya and First Bangkok City Bank.

Asia Equity said Thai Farmers Bank's net profit was expected to rise four percent in 1997, Siam Commercial Bank by 0.4 percent, while net profit at Bank of Ayudhya and First Bangkok City Bank would remain flat at 5.2 billion baht and 4.6 billion respectively.

Asia Equity's recommendations for investors to buy stocks of the four banks came after Standard and Poor's on Tuesday downgraded the credit ratings of Thai Farmers Bank and Siam Commercial Bank to BBB-plus/A2 from A-minus/A2.
"The market appeared to have fully discounted this announcement as the share prices of both banks remained unchanged on the day," Asia Equity said.
It said that in the short term, the banking sector had an immediate resistance at 750 points. If it breaks this, the next resistance will be at 800 points.
"On the downside, it has strong suport at 700 points," Asia Equity said.

The banking sector was at 740.47 points at the lunch break on Friday. By the lunch break, Thai Farmers retreated one baht to 117, First Bangkok City dropped 0.50 to 21.50 while Siam Commercial and Bank of Ayudhya were unchanged at 134 and 62.50 respectively.
